description: Track changed Codex turns without model calls, surface due work before the next turn, and recover missed Stop events.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/continuity-windows.ps1') 'session-start'; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/continuity-windows.ps1') 'turn-start'; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/continuity-windows.ps1') 'turn-stop'; exit $LASTEXITCODE"

powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/continuity-windows.ps1') 'session-end'; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
